subject: What just happened?
notes: Lead essay is a recap of recent weeks; deals section has five venture rounds and one private equity acquisition. Score Group is an industrial engineering services company, not clearly tech or venture-backed; included for completeness.

stories.headline: Anthropic went public last week with a 17% first-day pop, followed by a wider tech sell-off
stories.quote: Anthropic last week went public in a day-one 17% stock pop that mutated pretty quickly into a widespread tech rout.
stories.description: Maker of the Claude AI models

facts.text: Stock rose 17% on its first day of trading (last week).
facts.quote: Anthropic last week went public in a day-one 17% stock pop that mutated pretty quickly into a widespread tech rout.

facts.text: Still valued at over $1 trillion after Friday's drop.
facts.quote: The Claude maker, still valued over $1 trillion even after its stock

stories.headline: Tech rout: Nasdaq ends the week down 2.66% year-to-date; Dow and S&P 500 close in correction territory
stories.quote: The Nasdaq finished the week down 2.66% year-to-date, and both the Dow and the S&P 500 closed in correction territory.

facts.text: Nasdaq finished last week down 2.66% year-to-date; Dow and S&P 500 closed in correction territory.
facts.quote: The Nasdaq finished the week down 2.66% year-to-date, and both the Dow and the S&P 500 closed in correction territory.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang ousted as Nvidia CEO; successor not named, Arm's Rene Haas mentioned
stories.quote: After Jensen Huang’s shocking ouster, Nvidia reported earnings last week, revealing beats across the board.

facts.text: Arm's Rene Haas is mentioned as a possible next Nvidia CEO; nothing decided.
facts.quote: Arm’s Rene Haas keeps coming up, but nothing’s over until it’s over.

facts.text: A Microsoft outage that took down email happened on the same day Huang was ousted.
facts.quote: the Microsoft outage that took down email (on the same day Huang was ousted no less)

stories.headline: Nvidia reported earnings last week with beats across the board
stories.quote: After Jensen Huang’s shocking ouster, Nvidia reported earnings last week, revealing beats across the board.

stories.headline: $6.3 billion Binance hack reported on 29 Oct
stories.quote: It was only on Oct. 29 that news of the astonishing $6.3 billion Binance hack made headlines

stories.headline: Wave of outages: FAA ground stoppage on 13 Nov, Microsoft email outage, plus Chase, Bank of America, Apple and NSA internal systems
stories.quote: there’s been a frightening wave of outages, from the FAA ground stoppage on Nov. 13 to the Microsoft outage that took down email (on the same day Huang was ousted no less).

facts.quote: from the FAA ground stoppage on Nov. 13

facts.text: Outages also at Chase, Bank of America, Apple and internal NSA systems.
facts.quote: There have also been outages at Chase, Bank of America, Apple, and even internal systems at the NSA.

stories.headline: Acutronic Group raised $100 million, led by InterAlpen Partners and Hale Capital Partners
stories.quote: Acutronic Group, a Zurich- and Austin-based manufacturer of small jet engines and specialized aerospace equipment, raised $100 million in funding. InterAlpenPartners and HaleCapital Partners led the round and were joined by ICORGroup, PictetAlternativeAdvisors, and others.
stories.description: Manufacturer of small jet engines and specialized aerospace equipment

stories.headline: Promise Robotics raised C$40 million ($27.9 million) Series B, led by White Star Capital
stories.quote: Promise Robotics, a Toronto-based company that uses AI and robotics to manufacture prefabricated components for homebuilders, raised C$40 million ($27.9 million) in Series B funding. White StarCapital led the round
stories.description: Uses AI and robotics to manufacture prefabricated components for homebuilders

stories.headline: Archer raised $10 million, led by Volition Capital
stories.quote: Archer, a New York- and London-based AI recruiting platform that matches candidates with employers and recommends roles to job seekers, raised $10 million in funding. VolitionCapital led the round and was joined by existing investor AVP.
stories.description: AI recruiting platform matching candidates with employers

stories.headline: Helix raised $6 million pre-seed, led by Chicago Ventures
stories.quote: Helix, a Los Angeles-based startup that uses on-device voice checks to detect bots and verify users’ age and identity, raised $6 million in pre-seed funding. ChicagoVentures led the round
stories.description: On-device voice checks to detect bots and verify age and identity

stories.headline: Hoplite raised $5.5 million from Y Combinator, Relational Capital, Upside Ventures and others
stories.quote: Hoplite, a San Francisco- and Dublin-based startup that lets developers run AI coding agents in the cloud, raised $5.5 million from Y Combinator, RelationalCapital, UpsideVentures, and others.
stories.description: Lets developers run AI coding agents in the cloud

stories.headline: Orbe Novo Capital and Stellex Capital Management agreed to acquire Score Group from D2Zero; terms not disclosed
stories.quote: ScoreGroup, a Peterhead, Scotland-based provider of valve management, emissions management and precision engineering services, from D2Zero, backed by SCFPartners. Financial terms were not disclosed.
stories.description: Valve management, emissions management and precision engineering services provider
stories.acquirer: Orbe Novo Capital and Stellex Capital Management

facts.text: Seller is D2Zero, backed by SCF Partners; financial terms not disclosed.
facts.quote: from D2Zero, backed by SCFPartners. Financial terms were not disclosed.
